package: @astryxdesign/core

# Blockquote

A quotation block with a rule on its inline-start edge and secondary text color. Use to highlight quoted content, testimonials, or excerpts. The rule and padding are logical, so they move to the right edge in right-to-left locales.

**Import:** `import {Blockquote} from '@astryxdesign/core/Blockquote';`

## Anatomy

| Element | Required | Description |
|---------|----------|-------------|
| Rule | Yes | The border on the inline-start edge, drawn with --color-border-emphasized. |
| Quotation | Yes | The quoted content, passed as children. Renders inside the <blockquote> element. |
| Attribution | No | The source, passed as cite. Renders as a <cite> element below the quotation. |

## Best Practices

- **Do:** Use for quoted text, testimonials, or highlighted excerpts from external sources.
- **Do:** Provide a cite prop when the source of the quote is known.
- **Do:** Pass the source through cite rather than typing it into children, so it renders as a semantic <cite> element that assistive technology can distinguish from the quotation.
- **Don't:** Use for callout boxes or informational notes; use Banner for those.
- **Don't:** Wrap the attribution in your own <footer>. A <footer> inside a <blockquote> becomes a contentinfo document landmark, and a page with several quotes then reports several page footers.

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|------|------|---------|-------------|
| `children` | `ReactNode` | - | Content of the blockquote. **(required)** |
| `cite` | `ReactNode` | - | Optional attribution for the quote. Rendered in a <cite> element after the quoted content. |
| `xstyle` | `StyleXStyles` | - | StyleX styles for layout customization (margins, positioning, sizing). Must be a stylex.create() value, not an inline style object like style={{}}. |

## Theming

| Component class | Preferred data attributes | Props | States |
|-----------------|---------------------------|-------|--------|
| `astryx-blockquote` | - | - | - |

Override in defineTheme:
```ts
components: {
  'blockquote': {
    base: { /* CSS properties */ },
  },
}
```
